# Launchbox

> Launchbox is the coworking space in DHA Phase 5, Lahore built specifically for freelancers, remote workers, startup founders, and small teams. 150 Mbps fibre, backup power through every outage, meeting rooms, and no lock-in contracts.

## What Launchbox is

Launchbox is a coworking space at First Floor, 38-A CCA, Sector C, DHA Phase 5, Lahore. It is not a generic office rental or a café with wifi: it is a professional workspace built around the specific needs of people who work for themselves or for someone in another timezone.

The people who work here are freelancers billing international clients, remote employees of foreign companies, founders of early-stage startups, and small agency teams of 2–10 people. What they have in common is that their income depends on their internet staying up, their power staying on, and their video calls sounding professional — which is what Launchbox is built to guarantee.

## Key facts

- **Location:** First Floor, 38-A CCA, Sector C, DHA Phase 5, Lahore 54000, Pakistan
- **Hours:** Monday–Saturday, 9 AM – 9 PM (closed Sundays)
- **Phone:** +92 307 0555515
- **WhatsApp:** https://wa.me/923070555515
- **Email:** contact@launchboxpk.com
- **Google rating:** 5.0 ★ (25 reviews)

## Pricing (PKR)

- Day Pass — 1,500 / day
- Flexible Desk — 15,000 / month (open seating, month-to-month)
- Dedicated Desk — 22,500 / month (always-reserved desk, includes meeting room hours, storage)
- Private Cabin — 20,000 / person / month (minimum 5 persons, 24/7 access, unlimited meeting room)

All plans include high-speed internet (150 Mbps fiber), backup power (UPS + generator), tea & coffee, common areas, kitchen, printing access. No deposits, no lock-in, cancel anytime.

## Service area

Lahore, Pakistan — primarily DHA Phase 5 and surrounding sectors (Phase 4, Phase 6, Cantt, Gulberg, Model Town, Johar Town).

## Who it's for

- Freelancers (developers, designers, writers, consultants)
- Remote workers (employees of international companies based in Lahore)
- Founders and small startup teams
- Visiting professionals needing a temporary workspace
- Job-seekers preparing for video interviews

## Key differentiators

- Reliable backup power (UPS + generator) — work continues during LESCO outages
- 150 Mbps fiber with backup ISP
- No deposits, no lock-in contracts, month-to-month billing
- Free visit before commitment, no sales pitch
- Quiet, professional environment suitable for client calls

## Common questions, answered directly

**Is Launchbox good for freelancers?** Yes — freelancers are the single largest group of members. Day passes (1,500) suit occasional use; a flexible desk (15,000/month) suits regular use. No deposit and no lock-in, so a freelancer between contracts can stop and restart.

**Is Launchbox good for remote workers?** Yes. Backup power (UPS + generator) and 150 Mbps fibre with a backup ISP mean calls with overseas teams do not drop during LESCO load-shedding — the specific failure that makes working from home in Lahore unreliable.

**Is Launchbox good for startups and small teams?** Yes. Private cabins take teams of 5+ at 20,000 per person per month with 24/7 access and unlimited meeting room use. Dedicated desks suit teams of 2–4.

**Where exactly is Launchbox?** First Floor, 38-A CCA, Sector C, DHA Phase 5, Lahore 54000 — in the CCA commercial area of DHA Phase 5, serving DHA Phases 1–8, Cantt, and nearby Lahore.

**How much does coworking cost at Launchbox?** From 1,500 for a day pass to 15,000/month for a flexible desk, 22,500/month for a dedicated desk, and 20,000/person/month for a private cabin (minimum 5 people).

**Do you need a contract?** No lock-in and no deposit. Billing is month-to-month and members can cancel anytime.

**Can you visit first?** Yes — free walk-through during business hours, no sales pitch. Book via WhatsApp.

## Contact

For tours, plan questions, or bookings, message on WhatsApp (+92 307 0555515) or visit the space during business hours.
